facts.business: 3P Land Holdings Limited is a Core Investment Company that earns revenue primarily from interest, dividend, and rental income from leasing real estate to related parties.
key_risks: Land at Pune subject to applicability of repealed Urban Land Ceiling Act 1976, matter pending before Government authorities
Negative other comprehensive income due to fall in market price of shares held in Pudumjee Paper Products Ltd
Loan to associate company Biodegradable Products India Limited measured at amortised cost based on management's estimate, impairment assessment dependent on valuation assumptions
facts.related_party_note: Rental income from lease of real estate (land and buildings) at Pune granted to Pudumjee Paper Products Ltd., a related party, under a Leave & License Agreement renewed from 1st February 2026 for a period of five years. Additional loan of ₹223.00 lakhs given to Biodegradable Products India Limited (associate company), total loan outstanding ₹2198.71 lakhs as on March 31, 2026.
